pairsWith.noteUz: Ko'chirma buyruqlar (oshxona, dogsitter), undov gaplar what/how.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 15-UNIT MAShQLAR, 1-BET (73-bet, PDF 72). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '15'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Reported Instructions/Commands':
1) 'Turn the following sentences into reported speech.' SURAT: oshxonada ona, o'g'il va qiz xamir yoyishyapti. 1 "Don't forget to wash your hands!" Our mother told us not to forget to wash our hands. 2 "Pass me a bowl!" She told Jerry ... 3 "Get me some eggs from the fridge!" She told Susie ... 4 "Roll out the mixture!" She told Jerry ... 5 "Place it into the baking tin and then put it in the oven!" She told Susie ... 6 "Don't forget to close the oven door!" She told Susie ... 7 "Tidy the kitchen!" She told Susie and Jerry ...
2) 'Report what Mrs Cross told her dogsitter, as in the example.' SURAT: shlyapali ayol (Mrs Cross) va it yetaklagan dogsitter ayol; yashil gap bulutlari: 1 Give the dog a bath on Friday! 2 Take him for a walk three times a day! 3 Don't give him any sweets! 4 Keep his bowl full of water! 5 Don't let him bark all the time! 6 Feed him twice a day!

O'NG USTUN:
2) javob qatorlari: 1 Mrs Cross asked her dogsitter to give the dog a bath on Friday. 2-6 ...
'Exclamations':
3) 'Fill in what (a/an) or how.' 1 ... fantastic house they have! 2 ... horrible that film was! 3 ... lovely day! 4 ... excellent teacher she is! 5 ... terrible that fish tasted! 6 ... thoughtful of you to remember my birthday! 7 ... awful experience they had! 8 ... clever that man is! 9 ... great music they're playing! 10 ... easy that test was! 11 ... boring book that is! 12 ... hot it is in the house! 13 ... colourful painting! 14 ... wonderful that garden is! 15 ... dangerous dog that is!
4) 'Underline the correct word.' 1 A: David gave me a beautiful, silk scarf for my birthday. B: What/How a lovely surprise! 2 A: My brother broke his leg. B: How/What awful! 3 A: The baby said her first word yesterday. B: What/How wonderful! 4 A: Debra won first prize in the spelling contest. B: How/What proud you must be! 5 A: My dog died. B: What/How terrible news! 6 A: Andy didn't get the job. B: What/How a shame! 7 A: We watched the film Titanic again yesterday. B: How/What boring! 8 A: We've finally found a house. B: What/How a relief! 9 A: Helen got an A in her final test. B: What/How an excellent student she must be! 10 A: It never stopped raining when we were on holiday. B: How/What bad luck!

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '73'.

U Jerriga ... aytdi 3 'Muzlatgichdan tuxum olib kel!' U Syuziga ... aytdi 4 'Xamirni yoy!' U Jerriga ... aytdi 5 'Uni pishirish idishiga sol va duxovkaga qo'y!' exercises.explanationUz:
told + KIMGA + (not) TO + fe'l.

  1 Don't forget → NOT TO forget
    (NAMUNA); your → our
  2 Pass me → TO PASS HER (me →
    her - ona)
  3 Get me → TO GET HER
  4 Roll out → TO ROLL OUT
  5 Place it ... put it → TO PLACE
    it ... and then put it
  6 Don't forget → NOT TO forget
  7 Tidy → TO TIDY

  ⚠ 'me' → 'her' (buyruq bergan -
  ona).


⚠ 'ROLL OUT':

  = (xamirni) yoymoq.


⚠ 'BAKING TIN':

  = pishirish idishi.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 Our mother told us not to forget to wash our hands.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 Onamiz bizga qo'limizni yuvishni unutmaslikni aytdi.
modelAnswers: 1 Our mother told us not to forget to wash our hands.
2 She told Jerry to pass her a bowl.
3 She told Susie to get her some eggs from the fridge.
4 She told Jerry to roll out the mixture.
5 She told Susie to place it into the baking tin and then put it in the oven.
6 She told Susie not to forget to close the oven door.
7 She told Susie and Jerry to tidy the kitchen.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Onamiz bizga qo'limizni yuvishni unutmaslikni aytdi. (NAMUNA)
2 U Jerriga unga kosa uzatishni aytdi. (to pass her)
3 U Syuziga muzlatgichdan tuxum olib kelishni aytdi. (to get her)
4 U Jerriga xamirni yoyishni aytdi. (to roll out)
5 U Syuziga uni pishirish idishiga solib, duxovkaga qo'yishni aytdi. (to place ... put)
6 U Syuziga duxovka eshigini yopishni unutmaslikni aytdi. (not to forget)
7 U Syuzi va Jerriga oshxonani yig'ishtirishni aytdi. (to tidy)
